event_v0.doc: Emitted when the keeper is rotated.
event_v0.name: SetKeeperEvent

function_v0.doc: Deposits `amount` of the underlying, supplies it to Kinetic, and mints shares.\nReturns the vault's underlying-denominated balance after the deposit.
function_v0.name: deposit

function_v0.doc:
Claims one reward asset (named in `data`) and reinvests it. Keeper-gated.

Reward selection is supplied per call via `data` \xe2\x80\x94 an XDR-encoded
[`HarvestInstruction`] \xe2\x80\x94 instead of being fixed at construction, so the immutable
contract can compound reward assets Kinetic adds to the market over time. One reward
per call: the keeper enumerates the market's reward list off-chain and calls `harvest`
once per active token (see design doc \xc2\xa712).

- `None` / empty `data` => no-op (nothing to claim this call).
- Present-but-malformed `data` => `InvalidArgument` (a keeper encoding mistake; we
refuse rather than proceed).
- Nothing accrued for the named reward => no-op (don't revert \xe2\x80\x94 keeps keeper txs cheap).
function_v0.name: harvest

function_v0.doc: Withdraws `amount` of underlying from Kinetic to `to`, burning the matching shares.\nReturns the vault's remaining underlying-denominated balance.
function_v0.name: withdraw

event_v0.doc: Emitted when a depositor is added to (`allowed = true`) or removed from\n(`allowed = false`) the deposit allowlist.
event_v0.name: SetDepositorEvent

udt_struct_v0.doc:
A single reward-harvest instruction, supplied by the keeper in `harvest`'s `data`
payload (XDR-encoded). Kinetic markets carry an evolving *list* of reward assets and
this contract is not upgradable, so the reward token \xe2\x80\x94 plus its slippage floor and swap
route \xe2\x80\x94 is chosen per call rather than fixed in `Config`. One reward per `harvest`; the
keeper calls `harvest` once per active reward token it reads from Kinetic's incentives
list. See design doc \xc2\xa712.
udt_struct_v0.name: HarvestInstruction

fields.doc: Minimum acceptable output of the `reward_token -> asset` swap (slippage floor).
fields.name: min_out

fields.doc: Swap route. Empty => the default direct hop `[reward_token, asset]`; a longer path\nhandles reward assets with no direct pool to `asset` (e.g. `SOLV -> XLM -> USDC`).
fields.name: path

fields.doc: Reward asset to claim and compound this call.
fields.name: reward_token

function_v0.doc:
Rotates the keeper. Both parties must sign: the current keeper authorizes handing
the role over, and the NEW keeper proves the address is real and under its control \xe2\x80\x94
a typo'd or inaccessible address would otherwise permanently brick every
keeper-gated method (this contract is not upgradable).
function_v0.name: set_keeper

event_v0.doc: Emitted when a depositor *code hash* is added to (`allowed = true`) or removed from\n(`allowed = false`) the wasm-hash deposit allowlist.
event_v0.name: SetAllowedHashEvent

function_v0.doc: Whether `depositor` is currently on the address deposit allowlist.
function_v0.name: is_depositor

function_v0.doc:
Initializes the strategy.

`init_args` (4, in order):
1. `kinetic_router: Address`
2. `incentives: Address`
3. `swap_router: Address` \xe2\x80\x94 AMM router for reward -> asset swaps (Soroswap today)
4. `keeper: Address` \xe2\x80\x94 the only address allowed to harvest

The reward token is NOT fixed here: it is chosen per-`harvest` via the `data`
payload (see `harvest` and design doc \xc2\xa712), so the immutable contract can reach
reward assets Kinetic adds to the market after deployment.

The aToken address is resolved from the router for `asset` and cached in `Config`.

Construction is the only place this contract panics on bad input: a malformed
or short `init_args` aborts deployment via `.expect(...)` (each names the missing
arg). This is deployment-time and one-shot \xe2\x80\x94 there is no post-deploy code path
that can reach these panics \xe2\x80\x94 so returning a `Result` here buys nothing.
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc: Adds `depositor` to the deposit allowlist. Keeper-gated; idempotent. The allowlist\nstarts empty at construction, so the keeper must add the DeFindex vault before it\ncan deposit.
function_v0.name: add_depositor

function_v0.doc: Whether `hash` is currently on the wasm-hash deposit allowlist.
function_v0.name: is_allowed_hash

function_v0.doc:
Adds a contract `hash` (wasm code hash) to the deposit allowlist. Keeper-gated;
idempotent. Any contract whose code hash matches may then deposit, regardless of its
address \xe2\x80\x94 bless a vault's wasm once and every instance of it is allowed. Because vault
code hashes are known at build/upload time, the keeper can allowlist a hash before any
such vault is deployed. Note: a vault that upgrades its wasm changes hash and must be
re-blessed.
function_v0.name: add_allowed_hash

function_v0.doc: Removes `depositor` from the deposit allowlist. Keeper-gated; idempotent. This blocks\nonly *future* deposits from `depositor` \xe2\x80\x94 it never affects its ability to withdraw\nfunds it already holds.
function_v0.name: remove_depositor

function_v0.doc: Harvested profit still locked out of the share price at the current ledger time.
function_v0.name: get_locked_profit

event_v0.doc: Emitted when the keeper retunes the harvest-profit vesting window.
event_v0.name: VestingWindowUpdatedEvent

function_v0.doc: Current harvest-profit vesting window in seconds.
function_v0.name: get_vesting_window

function_v0.doc:
Retunes the harvest-profit vesting window. Keeper-gated; bounded to
[`MIN_VESTING_SECONDS`, `MAX_VESTING_SECONDS`]. Keep the window at least as long as
the harvest cadence \xe2\x80\x94 shorter, and a sniper can wait a window out between harvests
and still capture the full vested amount right before the next one.
function_v0.name: set_vesting_window

function_v0.doc: Removes a contract `hash` from the deposit allowlist. Keeper-gated; idempotent. Blocks\nonly *future* deposits from contracts running that code \xe2\x80\x94 never affects withdrawals.
function_v0.name: remove_allowed_hash

udt_struct_v0.doc:
Immutable strategy configuration, set once at construction.

Note there is no `b_rate` / `total_b_tokens` bookkeeping (unlike the Blend reference):
Kinetic's aToken is a live-value token, so NAV is read directly from it.
udt_struct_v0.name: Config

fields.doc: Underlying asset managed by the strategy (e.g. USDC).
fields.name: asset

fields.doc: aToken for `asset`, resolved from the router at construction.
fields.name: atoken

fields.doc: Kinetic router \xe2\x80\x94 supply / withdraw / index reads.
fields.name: kinetic_router

fields.doc:
AMM router used to swap a reward token -> `asset` on harvest. Venue-agnostic; see
`swap.rs`. Currently a Soroswap router.

Note: the reward token(s) are NOT fixed in config \xe2\x80\x94 Kinetic markets carry an
evolving *list* of reward assets, so the keeper names which reward to claim +
compound per `harvest` call via the `data` payload (see `lib.rs::harvest` and
design doc \xc2\xa712). This keeps the immutable contract able to reach reward assets
added to the market after deployment.
fields.name: swap_router

void_v0.doc: Last observed liquidity index \xe2\x80\x94 monotonicity tripwire (defense-in-depth).
void_v0.name: LastIndex

void_v0.doc: Harvested profit still vesting (locked out of the share price) as of `LockStart`.
void_v0.name: LockedProfit

void_v0.doc: Timestamp of the harvest that (re)started the current vesting window.
void_v0.name: LockStart

void_v0.doc: Length of the vesting window in seconds. Keeper-tunable within bounds; must stay at\nleast as long as the harvest cadence or a sniper can wait a window out between\nharvests and still capture the full vested amount.
void_v0.name: VestingSeconds

tuple_v0.doc: Allowlisted depositor by exact address (a specific DeFindex vault). Absent = not\nallowed. See also `AllowedHash` for code-identity allowlisting.
tuple_v0.name: Depositor

tuple_v0.doc: Allowlisted depositor by contract *code hash*: any contract whose wasm hash matches\nmay deposit, regardless of its address. Absent = not allowed. Lets every instance of\na blessed vault wasm deposit without per-address curation.
tuple_v0.name: AllowedHash
